tp4-ar.qualification: Not qualified: the M1 bring-up profile, autoregressive at TP4 on the deepseek-ai checkpoint with the native KV layout, which kv_cache_dtype auto serves. The BF16 KV layout is not a served profile: it is qual.json's kv-bf16 comparison configuration, not qualified for capacity, preemption under pressure or offload. Its evidence is the release preview's full suite at the release revision (models/deepseek41/README.md#qualification). Prefill runs exact upper-layer dependency intervals at guaranteed 8192-token chunk ends, prompt ends and scheduler-selected shared-prefix anchors aligned to 64 tokens, bitwise equal to the full schedule.

tp4-dspark.qualification: Not qualified: DSpark at TP4 on the deepseek-ai checkpoint with native KV. Confidence-allocated batches compute all five drafter heads and score only computed target rows through mapped sampling. Only unallocated uniform depth-three batches of 3-8 items compute three heads. On 2026-10-28, compact allocation resolved a 1.91% request-throughput gain for coding at four streams and 256 outputs, with no resolved regression across coding/chat at four/eight streams and 256 outputs or four streams and 1024 outputs; all used TP4 native KV and temperature 1.0. Widths above 64 rows are unqualified for timing. Qualification requires AR and speculative arms, exact greedy equality, the declared speculative-verification bounds and GSM8K at least 193 of 200 in each arm. Prefill runs exact upper-layer dependency intervals at guaranteed 8192-token chunk ends, prompt ends and scheduler-selected shared-prefix anchors aligned to 64 tokens, bitwise equal to the full schedule. DSpark prefill batches commit projections and overlaps per-layer Engram gathers by default. Prepared gathers apply only to supported schedules; upper-skip DMA from 512 rows keeps synchronous gathers.
